spans.s: धुट् (1) the augment ध् prefixed to the consonant स् following upon the consonant ड् or न् occurring at the end of a word; e.g. श्वलिट्त्साये, महान्त्साये etc.; cf.

; (2) technical short term for धातु (root); the technical term is धुष् , but the nom. sing. used is धुट्; (3) a technical term standing for con- sonants excepting semi-vowels and nasals; cf. धुटश्च धुटि Kat.
. The term is used in the Katantra Vyakarana. It corresponds to the term झर् of Panini.
